# Phone number input

Vendored libphonenumber-js 1.13.12 (MIT): https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js

The country dropdown and national-number parsing use the project's min bundle.
This handles calling codes, national trunk prefixes and possible lengths without
a new npm installation, handwritten country rules, or runtime CDN requests.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/libphonenumber-js/-/libphonenumber-js-1.13.12.tgz
